description: R-SQL-1 SQL-B: Where does SQL text length (UTF-16 units: 32000, 63999, 64000, 64001, 65535, 65536, 65537, 131072) stop being accepted, and at which phase? Only length varies: "SELECT" + spaces + " id FROM L". Each text is opened directly and through a temporary QueryDef (create, then OpenRecordset). Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
